description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 22.02.2016 to 28.02.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for import/export regulations.
